title: Second Ballade
identity: The University of Maryland NACWPI Score Collection catalogs Harry Gee’s Second Ballade for alto saxophone and piano, published by Kendor around 1980, with a 2:40 duration and a Grade 4 label. That label belongs to the collection record and is not a SaxoBrain level.

evidence.claim: University of Maryland NACWPI collection catalog record lists the Kendor alto-saxophone-and-piano Second Ballade, c.1980, duration 2:40, Grade 4.
evidence.source_name: University of Maryland Digital Collections, NACWPI Score Collection

review_focus: The collection record gives a 2:40 catalog duration and Grade 4 label. Both are record metadata; inspect the score for phrase length, range, and piano texture before drawing a technical conclusion.
collection_flag: Documented NACWPI collection catalog Grade 4 and duration; collection classification is not a new level recommendation.
gaps: The Maryland record is catalog metadata for a score collection; it does not provide readable notation in the opened record, and no score pages were inspected.
No current college programming or verified performance link found.
